title: timing replicate: with numba assembly and fork pruning the 192 / 96 fast variant j1 is no faster than the 288 / 144 champion without time recursion; recall variants cost +2 to +3 ms

a.recipe: wsl bash tools/env/_py14.sh p18_latency.py --name e123_D7_r3_j1 --M 192 --K0 96 --rec 0 --union 2 --fork_prune 0.3 --n 200 --tag e243_j1_r<k>, 4 replicates k = 1..4 interleaved with the other arms
a.note: fast variant j1; fork pruning 0.3 as in the stored j1_loop18 timing

c.recipe: same command with --name e123_D7_r3_f1 --M 288 --K0 144 (champion without time recursion, pruning 0.3)

b.recipe: e18_D7_j1eq, M 192, K0 96, rec 0, fork_prune 0.4, n 200, 4 interleaved replicates

d.recipe: e18_D7_j1rc, M 192, K0 96, rec 0, fork_prune 0.4, n 200, 4 interleaved replicates

e.recipe: e123_D7_r3_rc1, M 288, K0 144, rec 0, fork_prune 0.4, n 200, 4 interleaved replicates

f.recipe: e123_D7_r3_f1, M 288, K0 144, --rec 1, fork_prune 0.3, n 200, 4 interleaved replicates
f.note: champion as trained (time recursion); stored 24.2 ms

rule.note: KEEP only if j1 is faster than the champion by at least the 1.0 ms band; the expected outcome is TIE (the cheaper arm then wins on quality per ms, not on ms)
guard: the assembly share does not grow

kill: discard and repeat a replicate if nvidia-smi shows another GPU process or GPU utilisation above 5 % before the start (the stored j1 pair 19.71 vs 17.26 ms is such a case: a 2.4 ms spread inside one configuration); stop at 0.6 h; a replicate with less than 200 timed frames is void
